stem: Which ending result or final point follows “The closed pool had seemed like only bad news.”?
options: It became the reason the town found more ways for children to spend summer days.
It became a lesson in problem-solving: when land, food, and cities change, people must imagine new ways to grow.
The library became quieter without Page, but everyone knew it now had a warmer home.
The free book box reminds the town that sharing can happen quietly in public places.
